title: UI风格#214 - Retro Diner Modern (现代餐车)
description: 创建第214种UI风格：现代餐车风格 - 现代版50年代餐厅、活力与怀旧。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planHF.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Diner Modern style When color palette Then features cherry red, teal, cream, chrome silver
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#DC143C (樱桃红), #008080 (青色), #FFFDD0 (奶油), #C0C0C0 (铬银)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Diner Modern style When typography Then uses retro modern: Pacifico, Josefin Sans, Quicksand

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Diner Modern style When layout Then sleek booth design, modern chrome, neon accents
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：时尚卡座设计、现代铬合金、霓虹点缀

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Diner Modern style When UI elements Then neon glow, chrome shine, vinyl texture
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：霓虹发光、铬合金光泽、乙烯基纹理

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Diner Modern UI When functional Then includes order chat, server agents, tip stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：点餐聊天、服务员代理、小费统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Diner Modern UI When copy Then uses diner: 'Order', 'Served', 'Fresh', 'Daily'
